Ghostery network blocking dependencies

The browser uses unmodified @ghostery/adblocker 2.18.2. It does not use the
Electron wrapper's listener installer, extension loader, cosmetic IPC or
security-warning suppression. No covered upstream source files were modified.

below. These source notices and licenses must remain with distributions of
the bundled code. MPL obligations apply to the covered files, not unrelated
terminal-browser files. The project's MIT license does not relicense them.
